headline: 《生死时限》领跑影院，《狂热先生》开播热议
summary: 今日电影市场由《生死时限》领跑，温馨新作《给阿嬷的情书》同受关注；电视端新剧《狂热先生》首播吸睛，热播剧《权力的游戏前传：龙族》仍强势。待映《生化危机：爆发夜》与待播《无间兄弟情》等后续蓄力。

industryHighlights.text: 《生死时限》今日登顶电影热作榜首，动作题材热度领先。
industryHighlights.en: “Deadline” tops today’s movie chart, leading with action-packed appeal.

industryHighlights.text: 本周新剧《狂热先生》首播，火速进入热播讨论视线。
industryHighlights.en: New series “Mr. Fanatic” premiered this week and quickly became a hot topic.

industryHighlights.text: 《权力的游戏前传：龙族》持续热播，维持剧集热度高点。
industryHighlights.en: “House of the Dragon” keeps strong momentum as a top ongoing series.

industryHighlights.text: 多部待映待播新作蓄势，《生化危机：爆发夜》等备受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films and series are highly anticipated, including “Resident Evil: Outbreak Night.”

summaryEn: The movie market is led by “Deadline,” with the heartwarming “A Letter to Grandma” also drawing attention. On TV, new series “Mr. Fanatic” premieres strongly, while “House of the Dragon” remains a hit. Upcoming titles like “Resident Evil: Outbreak Night” and “Brotherhood” are also building buzz.
